title: Blocky Matrices and Group Idempotents
summary: We prove a common generalization of two structure theorems: the dimension-free decomposition theorem for idempotent Schur multipliers and the idempotent theorem in harmonic analysis. Roughly speaking, our result shows that an invariant integer-valued kernel with Hilbert-space factorization norm $γ$ admits a signed decomposition into at most $2^{O(γ^4)}$ elementary pieces. In the matrix setting these pieces are blocky matrices, while in the group setting they are indicators of cosets. In the locally compact abelian setting this quantitatively strengthens the theorem of Green and Sanders,…
